item.title: Version 0.6.0
item.description:
# SolWhisper v0.6.0
A new on-screen translation tool, a far smoother meeting pipeline, and a round of reliability fixes that make long-meeting summaries and diarization stop timing out.
## Headline feature
### 🌐 Translate from screen Capture any text on screen and get an instant translation on your clipboard — no copy-paste, no switching apps.
- **Screen-snip OCR** — drag a region, the text is recognized locally. - **Translate to clipboard** — the result lands on your clipboard, ready to paste anywhere. - Polished result bubble with a clean dismiss flow.
## Meetings
- **Live pipeline progress** — Transcribe → Clean → Diarize → Summarize now show as a staged progress strip so you can see exactly where a meeting is in processing. - **Polished summaries** — cleaner Markdown output and better section structure. - **Cancel button for diarization** — stop an in-flight diarize run cleanly instead of waiting it out.
## Reliability & performance
- **Summaries no longer time out on long meetings.** Per-request timeouts raised from the 60-second default to 5 minutes, and summaries now stream as they generate — so a multi-minute generation keeps the connection alive instead of failing with "The request timed out." - **Transient provider errors auto-retry.** 502 / 503 / 504 / rate-limit and network blips retry with backoff instead of surfacing as a hard failure. HTTP errors now read as plain sentences rather than raw HTML. - **Faster, cheaper summaries.** A cheap pre-pass classifies the meeting type so the summary prompt ships only the relevant template (≈21k fewer input tokens), consecutive same-speaker segments are collapsed, and the static skill prompt is cached on Anthropic for big repeat-run savings. - **Diarization upload progress.** AssemblyAI and Deepgram now stream the audio from disk and show real upload progress, so the bar no longer parks at 5% during the multi-minute upload of a long recording.
## Voice profiles
- **Un-stuck voiceprint capture** — capturing a voiceprint no longer hangs. - **Backfill** — existing name-only profiles graduate to stored voiceprints.
## Fixes
- Meeting recording: drop stray chunks beyond the first; more reliable calendar auto-linking. - Audio: release the vDSP DFT setup on stop (no leak). - Meeting: allow restarting after any ScreenCaptureKit failure. - Deepgram: stop printing raw transcript output to the log.
## Compatibility & known limitations
- **macOS 14+** required. - **Notarization** — this build is signed but **not yet notarized** by Apple. macOS may warn on first launch; right-click → Open (or System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway) the first time. Notarized builds resume once the Developer ID is in hand.
## Upgrade
- **Sparkle auto-update** — installed users are prompted automatically once the appcast updates. - **Fresh install** — download the DMG from the GitHub release page. - **Settings preserved** — model configs, skill packs, voice profiles, and meeting history carry forward unchanged.

item.title: Version 0.5.0
item.description:
# SolWhisper v0.5.0
The biggest release since launch — full speaker diarization, an MCP server that makes Claude Desktop / Cursor / Zed meeting-aware, voice profiles for recurring collaborators, and calendar integration. Plus a major LLM-routing expansion and a polished transcript UI.
## Headline features
### 🎙 Speaker diarization Real **Speaker A / B / C** labels on every transcript — not just the channel-based `[Me] / [Other]` split that only worked for live two-channel recordings. Imported files now get proper speaker separation too.
- **Three engines**: AssemblyAI (cloud, accurate on noisy audio), Deepgram (cloud, fast), FluidAudio (local CoreML pyannote, scaffolded for full on-device privacy in v0.6). - **Per-segment letter assignment** mapped onto your existing transcript by time-overlap. - **LLM-powered name suggestions** — "Speaker A → Pierre, Speaker B → Ricardo" inferred from meeting context, calendar attendees, and transcript content. Per-row review with confidence scoring.
### 🔌 MCP server — make your AI assistant meeting-aware - **Bundled local binary** (`solwhisper-mcp`) ships inside the app, ready for Claude Desktop / Cursor / Zed. - **One-click config snippets** in Settings → Integrations → MCP server — copy the JSON for Claude Desktop or Cursor, paste, done. - **Stdio transport** — no network port, no exposure beyond the parent process. - **5 tools**: `list_meetings`, `get_meeting`, `search_transcripts`, `list_dictation_history`, `list_skills`. - **3 resource URIs per meeting**: transcript Markdown, summary Markdown, metadata JSON. - Use case: "Claude, summarize my last sales call" / "Find the action item from yesterday's standup" — answered without leaving your assistant.
### 👥 Voice profiles - Save a name + voice fingerprint for any speaker in any transcript via the rename popover's **Save** button. - 256-dim embeddings extracted locally via FluidAudio — never leaves the device. - Each named speaker becomes a profile that future meetings can auto-match against (full auto-matching lands in v0.6 once the embedding pipeline is fully wired through diarization). - Settings → People shows every profile with its current state ("name only" vs. "voiceprint stored") and a one-click delete.
### 📅 Calendar integration - macOS Calendar attendees from the event scheduled around recording time become **rename suggestions** in the speaker popover. - Match-and-confirm dialog when multiple events overlap. - Attendees also feed into the LLM speaker matcher for higher-quality auto-naming. - Granted lazily — no permission prompt until you opt in.
### 🤖 Multi-provider LLM routing - **Six direct integrations** added/expanded: Anthropic (Claude 4.7 / 4.6 / 4.5), OpenAI (GPT-4o, o1, o3), Google (Gemini 2.0 Flash + 1.5 Pro), Groq (Llama 3.3, DeepSeek R1), OpenRouter (everything else), Ollama (local). - **Per-role routing** — Dictation cleanup, Meeting cleanup, and Meeting summary each get their own model. Mix providers freely. - **Configured Models picker** with provider icons, edit, delete. Every preset list updated to current model generations. - **Legacy model migration** — old configs auto-upgrade silently on launch.
### 📚 Meeting-summary skill pack - 10 type-specific summary templates that go far beyond generic bullet lists: - **Client discovery** — MEDDIC / BANT-lite qualification - **Architectural review** — ADR-style decisions with context, options, consequences, revisit-when - **Hiring interview** — per-competency signal table, evidence-quoted, with bias guardrails - **1:1** — CAPS (Career, Achievements, Problems, Support) with privacy redaction rules - **Scrum standup** — round-robin per-person status table + escalations - **Retrospective** — Start / Stop / Continue with action ownership - **Exploration** — analytical ideation with hypotheses, references, JTBD - **Development session** — pair-programming gotchas, TODOs, design decisions inline - **User interview** — JTBD framework, verbatim-quote rules, hypothesis tracking - **Creative brainstorm** — full idea inventory, themes, top picks, parking-lot - **Auto-detect** meeting type from transcript, or pick manually. - **Custom skills** — built-in flat-skill editor for your own quick templates. - **Editable skill pack** — every Markdown module ships into your user folder; tweak with any editor.
## Polished transcript UI
- **New muted speaker palette** — eight desaturated tones designed for dark backgrounds, replacing the saturated SwiftUI defaults. Same hash-stable assignment. - **Tighter column spacing** — consistent 20px gaps between timestamp, speaker, and text columns. - **Em-dash placeholder** for unknown speakers so the text column stays aligned. - **Your own name in white** — set your display name in Settings → People → You, and every speaker badge matching your name (case-insensitive) plus the `[Me]` mic channel renders in white. Spot yourself at a glance across any transcript. - **Unified Save button** in the rename popover — renames the speaker *and* captures a voiceprint in a single click. The earlier two-button "Save / Save as profile" split is gone. - **Improved popover title** — "Speaker B is…" instead of "Rename Speaker B" so it flows into the input field. - **Profile dedupe + upgrade** — saving a name that already exists as a name-only profile no longer skips the embedding capture. Existing profiles silently graduate to voiceprint-stored.
## Settings reorganization
- **Settings → People** — voice profiles + calendar access + your own display name in one place. - **Settings → Integrations → MCP server** — one-click config snippets for Claude Desktop and Cursor. - **Settings → Models** — visual library with provider icons, edit pencil, delete. Per-role assignment.
## Under the hood
- New `Sources/Diarization/` module — engine abstraction + AssemblyAI / Deepgram / FluidAudio adapters. - New `Sources/People/` module — `VoiceProfile`, `VoiceProfileStore`, `VoiceProfileEmbedder`, `VoiceMatcher`. - New `Sources/Integrations/CalendarIntegration.swift` — EventKit wrapper with status reporting. - New `Sources/LLM/` clients — `OpenAIClient`, `GoogleClient`, `GroqClient` direct integrations alongside Anthropic + OpenRouter + Ollama. - New `Sources/PostProcessing/` — `SkillPackLoader`, `SkillsRegistry`, `CleanReportSheet`, `CleanupPass` rewrite. - `MCP/` directory — separate `solwhisper-mcp` build target, packaged inside `SolWhisper.app/Contents/MacOS/`. - Schema migrations on `Meeting` + `TranscriptSegment` for diarization metadata.
## Compatibility & known limitations
- **macOS 14+** required for voiceprint extraction (FluidAudio's floor). macOS 13 still gets every other feature; voice profiles fall back to name-only. - **Voiceprint capture** still requires a diarized meeting (segments tagged with letter `speakerID`). Live recordings on `[Me] / [Other]` channels need a Diarize pass first before saving profiles. - **Auto-matching** of voiceprints across meetings is scaffolded but not yet wired end-to-end — lands in v0.6. - **MCP server** is read-only in v0.5. Mutating tools (delete meeting, edit transcript, mark action complete) come in v0.6. - **Notarization** — this build is signed with a developer certificate but **not yet notarized** by Apple. macOS may show a warning on first launch; right-click → Open the first time. Notarized builds resume in the next release once the certificate is in hand.
## Upgrade
- **Sparkle auto-update** — already-installed users will be prompted automatically once the appcast updates. - **Fresh install** — download the DMG from the GitHub release page. - **Settings preserved** — your existing model configs, skill packs, and meeting history carry forward unchanged.
